title: two-orders-duality
description: The theorem that the bilattice's knowledge-order closure theory and truth-order closure theory are structurally isomorphic via conjugation by the order-swap involution sigma on FOUR; generated by recognizing that sigma carries the two orders of the bilattice into one another.

order-swap-involution.description: sigma : FOUR -> FOUR, the involution bottom<->f, t<->top.

swaps-orders.description: sigma is an isomorphism of posets (FOUR, <=_k) <-> (FOUR, <=_t), taking knowledge-order covers to truth-order covers and back

cellwise-lift-equivalence.description: the pointwise lift sigma_*(v) = sigma o v is an involutive auto-equivalence of the predication-presheaves category

order-intertwining.description: for any <=_k-monotone-and-inflationary closure operator T_k, the conjugate T_t := sigma_* T_k sigma_*^{-1} is a <=_t-closure operator (truth-order closure)

settling-correspondence.description: every T_k-settling corresponds to a T_t-settling sigma_*(v) with the same closure ordinal kappa and the same firing-pattern combinatorics, via T_t^tau sigma_* = sigma_* T_k^tau

cohomology-identification.description: the settling cohomologies match: H^n(F_v) ~= H^n(F_{sigma_*(v)}) as Z-modules

extended-symmetry-group.description: sigma together with the Klein-four group K_4 = <neg, conf> generates a non-abelian 8-element group G_8 whose orbit structure refines the K_4-orbit classification of settlings.
